title: MA Protocol: Steroid Injection (IM)
desc: MA workflow for IM steroid injection including verification, technique, and documentation.

blocks.content: Prepare Kenalog-40 (triamcinolone acetonide, 40 mg/mL) and Decadron (dexamethasone, 4 mg/mL)
Draw 1 mL from each vial using a 22-gauge needle in 3mL Syringe — total volume 2 mL (40 mg triamcinolone + 4 mg dexamethasone). Change the needle to a long 24G for injection.
Check vial: medication name, concentration, lot number, expiration date

Position the patient facing a wall and have them lean forward with their hands resting against it (to prevent movement). Then request access to either the ventrogluteal or dorsogluteal injection site.
Aspirate before injecting — confirm no blood return
